collections.name: UIAA Alpine 4000ers
collections.listSource: International Climbing and Mountaineering Federation (UIAA), The 4000ers of the Alps, 1994. Tabulated in Wikipedia, “List of mountains of the Alps over 4000 metres” (accessed 29 Oct 2026).
collections.listLicence: Wikipedia article text and table are CC BY-SA 4.0. Elevations, countries, sub-ranges and normal-route notes are copied from that table. Coordinates are Wikidata P625 (CC0).

peaks.name: Mont Blanc
peaks.normalRoute: Par les Grands Mulets - Itinéraire classique
peaks.coordSource: Wikidata coordinate (P625), CC0, via the English Wikipedia sitelink for this summit.
peaks.sourceNote: Wikipedia's list also gives the Goûter Route as PD- to PD+. Camptocamp's easiest classic route, the Grands Mulets, is PD-.

peaks.coordSource: Wikidata coordinate (P625), CC0, via the English Wikipedia sitelink for this summit.
peaks.sourceNote: Wikipedia lists this normal continuation as PD- to PD+. Recorded as PD+, the harder end. Camptocamp does not catalogue that short ridge separately; its routes from this summit start at AD+.
